tr.title: embarrassed ne demek? (meşhur tuzak)
tr.metaDesc: embarrassed ne demek? 'Hamile' değil, 'utanmış, mahcup'. İspanyolca embarazada ile karıştırılan en ünlü tuzak — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: embarrassed ünlü bir tuzaktır: İspanyolca embarazada (“hamile”) sanılır ama aslında “utanmış, mahcup, rezil olmuş” demektir. (“Hamile” = pregnant.)

en.title: What does embarrassed mean? (famous trap)
en.metaDesc: What does embarrassed mean? Not 'pregnant' — it means 'ashamed, awkward'. The classic false friend with Spanish embarazada — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: embarrassed is a famous trap for Spanish speakers: it looks like embarazada (“pregnant”) but means “ashamed, awkward, ill at ease”. (For “pregnant” use pregnant.)

means.en: I was so embarrassed when I forgot her name.
He felt embarrassed in front of everyone.
They were financially embarrassed.
She's pregnant. (NOT embarrassed)

ja.title: embarrassedの意味は？（有名な罠）
